title: In Situ (8.7 cm)
summary: One byte-identical striped element is reclassified as a line, an awning, or a painting purely by the size of the frame it sits in.
mechanism: CSS @container (container-type: inline-size) queries the frame, not the viewport, so identical markup switches category live on native resize — zero JavaScript.
references: Daniel Buren, 8.7 cm striped outil visuel / in-situ works (1965– )
